title: computer_6
body:
**A Brief Introduction**

"The unexamined life is not worth living." - Socrates  

These words ring true most of all when it comes to Minecraft. One must “Know thyself” before truly knowing the game. This is the beginning of all wisdom.  

What does it mean to know your Minecraft? You must understand your performance, the tools at your fingertips, how the world affects you, and how you impact it in return.  

Between us and our beloved blocky world stands an invisible barrier — the screen. We crave more: smoother gameplay, lighter clients, smarter tools… more power.  

As humans often do, we long for true optimization. Today, I humbly present **computer_6** — a modest but carefully crafted client-side modpack.  

I am no genius, I am no pioneer — but through this project, **computer_6** offers real support.  

Never again will you be slowed by bloat. Never again will you lack essential tools when you need them most. Never again will you have to ask…  

**“What Is My Performance???”**

---

**What?? How??**  

**computer_6** achieves greatness by selecting only the best the Minecraft community has to offer while staying extremely lightweight. It delivers smooth performance and practical utility no matter your playstyle.  

Through rigorous testing and deliberate removal of heavy mods, **computer_6** guarantees a clean, stable, and high-performance experience.  

Built for everyone — from new players who want a deeper understanding of the game, to redstone engineers and builders who need precision tools, to content creators looking for an optimized workflow.  

Carefully preconfigured to keep your game fast and clean, **computer_6** promises:  

❌ **No unnecessary bloat!**  
Many performance-heavy mods have been deliberately removed — only what truly matters remains.  

✅ **Easy customization!**  
Pre-tuned settings, ready keybinds, and clean Mod Menu integration let you adjust everything to your liking.  

❌ **No cluttered or hard-to-read elements!**  
Everything is clear and well-placed right from the start.  

✅ **Extremely lightweight and efficient!**  
A true client-side modpack that gives you everything you need without the junk.  

This pack is the sum of its parts, made possible by the incredible Minecraft modding community. Here are the key components that make **computer_6** special:

**Core Utility & Information Mods**  
- Masa’s full suite (MiniHUD, Tweakeroo, Litematica, etc.)  
- JEI (Just Enough Items)  
- Xaero’s Minimap trio  
- Waystones  
- Chat Heads  
- Mod Menu  
- WTHIT  
- Durability display & warning  

**Performance & Optimization Mods**  
- Sodium  
- Entity rendering optimizations  
- Carpet  
- Universal Skin Patch  

**Quality-of-Life Mods**  
- Bilingual item names on screen  
- Inventory / backpack sorting  
- Auto fishing  
- MCDR command completion  

**Provided by computer_6**  
**Updated to 1.01 on 2025.11.06**  
Includes redstone optimization and performance optimization mods.

⚠️ **What Is The Catch??**  
No catch! **computer_6** is offered completely free as a community service. It will never ask for your money or personal information.  

A few things to note:  
- Designed primarily for 16:9 screens (1080p recommended), but works well on most resolutions including ultra-wide.  
- Some mods are disabled by default for compatibility or to keep the pack lightweight — re-enable at your own risk.  
- Performance mods like Sodium are included to boost FPS and rendering. Feel free to disable them if you prefer a different visual style.  

**This pack is extremely lightweight!** Many performance-heavy mods have been removed so you can enjoy a smooth and responsive experience.
